title: Text disappears from a code span containing `<!--[if mso]>`
spec: This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`. Writing about Outlook conditional comments in inline code loses part of the code span. It seems to happen when two such unterminated comment openers appear in the same paragraph. Input: `markdown.markdown('Test `
acceptance: The reported input renders as expected
Other bogus or unclosed comment openers inside code spans are kept verbatim
